epics.sixSigmaMetric: 100% pass rate for E2E dossier generation paths
requirements: R1: Filter employee documents by arbitrary periods (month, multiple months, full year).
R2: Filter employee documents by scientific direction (virology, bacteriology, epidemiology, vaccination).
R3: Provide granular document type and employee filtering.
R4: Export the resulting dossier summary into a single PDF file.

R5: Seed initial employee document data for verification (e.g. 'Справка о результатах научной работы за январь-март 2023', 'Приказ о направлении в очаг инфекции №42', 'Отчет о вакцинопрофилактике (вирусология) 2024').
R6: Ensure exact denominator bounds and rigorous metric definitions when calculating dossier statistics, per Engineering Invariants Charter.

slices.title: Define Employee Dossier API Contract
slices.jtbd: When designing the API for this epic, I want a strict OpenAPI contract, so that backend and frontend can implement the dossier capabilities in parallel.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the requirement for dossier filtering and export,
When the API contract is defined,
Then it includes endpoints for arbitrary period, direction, and type filtering, plus a PDF export route.
Given the engineering invariants charter,
When defining the metrics endpoints,
Then the schema explicitly details the denominator and bounds for statistical calculations.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: 0 backward compatibility breaks in API contract

slices.title: Employee Dossier Data Model
slices.jtbd: When designing the schema for this epic, I want to store document attributes and scientific directions, so that granular filtering is possible.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a new document to be tracked,

Then it records the date, scientific direction, document type, and associated employee.
Given the acceptance floor requirement,
When the database is initialized,
Then real initial employee document data is seeded.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: 100% of required filter dimensions are indexed

slices.title: Implement Employee Dossier Backend
slices.jtbd: When implementing the dossier backend for this epic, I want to build filtering and PDF export logic, so that users can generate comprehensive reports.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:

Given a request to export a dossier summary,
When the backend generates the document,
Then it returns a properly formatted single PDF file.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Sub-10 second PDF generation time for standard dossiers

slices.title: Implement Employee Dossier Frontend
slices.jtbd: When building the UI for this epic, I want filtering controls and a download button, so that users can interactively build and export dossiers.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:

Given the user wants a report,

slices.sixSigmaMetric: 100% of filtering actions provide immediate UI feedback

slices.title: Verify Employee Dossier Features
slices.jtbd: When verifying this epic, I want full coverage of the filtering and export paths, so that the capability is proven functional end-to-end.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
